ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description:
Optional. The AI writes a short assessment below `/deal` and answers `/ask`. It only sees the prices from Pricewatcha, and the deterministic table is always sent too.

Examples: DeepSeek `https://api.deepseek.com` with `deepseek-flash`; OpenAI `https://api.openai.com/v1` with your model; Ollama on your network `http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1` with `llama3.1` and an empty key.

With web search on, `/ask` uses DeepSeek's native search or DuckDuckGo (SearXNG if configured) and cites the sources; `/deal` stays catalog-only. The key is stored in Home Assistant's `.storage` in plain text. A budget of 0 means no limit. The language is set under General.

error.invalid_url: The base URL must start with http:// or https://.
error.searxng_url_required: Enter the SearXNG base URL when SearXNG is the selected provider.

telegram_no_allowed_chat.title: Telegram bot ignores Pricewatcha
telegram_no_allowed_chat.description:
Home Assistant's Telegram bot drops every message from chats that are not allowed, so Pricewatcha never sees your commands.

Open **Settings → Devices & services → Telegram bot**, choose **Add allowed chat** and enter your chat id (message @userinfobot in Telegram to see it), then message the bot again.

This fixes itself once a chat is added; the repair disappears after the integration reloads.
